description:
Public X (Twitter) profile: bio, location, verification, follower/following/tweet/like/media/listed counts, avatar and banner.
Cost: 1 credit per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Returns: user_id (string, nullable), username (string), full_name (string), biography (string), location (string), external_url (string, nullable), is_private (boolean), is_verified (boolean), is_blue_verified (boolean), follower_count (integer, nullable), following_count (integer, nullable), tweet_count (integer, nullable), like_count (integer, nullable), media_count (integer, nullable), listed_count (integer, nullable), created_at (string, nullable), profile_image_url (string, nullable), profile_banner_url (string, nullable).

username.description: X username, @handle or profile URL. Example: "tesla"

name: x_profile
title: X profile
